ValidationRule.description: The moving contact and the move to account must have the same parent account.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT($Profile.Name = "Omni System Admin"), RecordType.Name ="Move Contact" && Contact__r.RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Standard' &&
Contact__r.Account.ParentAccount__c <> Move_to_Account__r.ParentAccount__c )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Contact can only be moved to another branch in the same company. Contact omnisolutions@omnicable.com for assistance.
